description: Break the single-CTA SIMT block-eigh ceiling by putting its O(k^3) work on TENSOR CORES. brief-43 proved (3 built+measured attempts) the mega_eigh_med_split_k tridiag is 72.8% barrier/divergence-stalled and irreducible within the SIMT-SMEM kernel family; blocked-WY only pays when the trailing update becomes a tensor-core GEMM, which that kernel cannot provide. The well-conditioned spectrally-gapped sign-DC blocks (K~300) are ideal inputs. Try either (a) a Successive Band Reduction tridiag whose trailing updates are WMMA/CUTLASS tensor-core GEMMs, or (b) route the K~300 blocks to a fill-the-GPU batched cuSOLVER syevd. This kernel is shared by shapes 2/3/8/11/12 so a win compounds across all five.

option (b) probe: route sign-DC (2b,K,K)=(1280,300,300) blocks to batched cuSOLVER torch.linalg.eigh. Measured crossover vs SIMT megakernel: shape 11 104188->179560us (+72%) -- the per-matrix syevd loop serializes, the one-CTA batched megakernel wins at K=300/B=1280. Shapes 2/3/8/12 unchanged. geomean 32166->33594us (regression).

Validates 39/39, 0 fallback (gate-correct). Shape 11 104188->241352us (2.3x slower): panel latrd is ~320 sequential batched-GEMV steps (10 panels x nb=32) -> launch+dispatch overhead + memory-bound symv dominate, negating the tensor-core trailing win. Structural fix open: SBR full->band (few panels, all level-3), larger nb, or a batched/fused panel. geomean 32166->34299us.

fused-panel latrd, occupancy play: Y,W moved to global so SMEM (FP16 triangle+v ~104KB) fits 2 CTAs/SM (was 1). Shape 11 146763->140385us. Validates 39/39, 0 fallback, shapes 2/3/8/12 unchanged (parent mega path). The latrd symv is O(K^3) FP16-SMEM-bound (ncu t5: 73.8% mem-throughput, ~9.3ms/largest-panel) -- SAME order as the parent fused stage-1 (~28ms) but with per-panel reload + torch-orchestration, so the direct full->tridiag family asymptotes ABOVE the parent 104188us (t2 241->t6 140ms). Open lever: SBR full->band (block-QR + two-sided tensor-core GEMM, NO per-column symv) then band->tridiag. geomean 32920->32951 (noise).

New kernels: mega_tridiag_eigh_k (Sturm+twisted stages 2/3 only, 6.7ms) + latrd_panel_k (fused per-panel LAPACK latrd, symv from packed FP16 SMEM triangle, divergent rank-2 update REMOVED -> deferred to the torch tensor-core syr2k GEMM) + torch WY back-transform. Validates 39/39, 0 fallback, shapes 2/3/8/12 UNCHANGED (parent mega path). Progression: t2 241352 (pure-torch, ~7000 launches) -> t3 183826 (fused panel, symv-from-global) -> t4 167641 (FP16 SMEM symv) -> t5 146763 (single-pass correction dots) -> t6 140385 (Y,W to global, occupancy). VERIFIED the brief thesis: latrd_panel_k barrier-stall DROPPED to 46.0% (from parent 73.5%) and the trailing update IS on tensor cores (cutlass3x_sm100_tensorop tf32). BUT the block-eigh total (latrd~47.5ms + tridiag 6.7ms + trailing GEMMs ~= 54ms) stays ABOVE the parent's single fused 34.5ms: the residual per-column symv is O(K^3) FP16-SMEM-bandwidth-bound (ncu t6: 67% mem-throughput, Block Limit Shared Mem=1), the SAME order as the parent stage-1, and the torch per-panel orchestration (FP16 re-pack + global Y,W reads + GEMM sync between panels) costs the ~2x gap. Shape 11 140385 vs parent 104188 -- a measured regression; geomean 32166->32951.

OPEN / NOT built (the lever that changes the O(K^3) symv complexity): true 2-stage SBR full->BAND. Full->band via block-QR panels whose two-sided update is Atr@Y as a batched tensor-core GEMM (NO per-column symv at all -- the direct form's wall), reducing to bandwidth bw, then band->tridiag via bulge-chasing with a BAND-AWARE symv (O(bw*K) per column, not O(K^2)). Flop estimate: full->band ~10-15ms level-3 + band->tridiag ~5-10ms band-limited could total ~20-25ms < parent 34.5ms. Risk: batched bulge-chasing + the two-stage WY back-transform composition (Q=Q1.Q2). All the stage-2/3 + WY-back-transform + FP16-scale machinery I built is reusable for it. Also open: in-kernel WMMA rank-2 update inside a single fused kernel (keeps the parent's single-launch efficiency AND tensor-cores the update). latrd_panel_k nb fixed at 32 (register-array cap); a 2-CTA-per-matrix split of the FP16 triangle would relieve the SMEM cap that pins occupancy at 1 CTA/SM.
